event_text: PLAID detects the unauthorised access, which began in the early hours, and starts stopping all KARTE services
notes: Time from PLAID's Nov 16 notice. That is 6:59 PM Eastern on Thu Nov 12.

event_text: PLAID tells ZOZO; ZOZO stops its data link to KARTE
PLAID's investigation finds that data ZOZO managed on KARTE had leaked
PLAID publishes its first notice confirming that data leaked, and that the attacker took credentials
ZOZO publishes its notice with the counts; PLAID publishes its investigation results and a mid-January restart target
